_doc: Bomb's objective rules that every format shares (Phase 6; game/shared/src/match/DESIGN.md §8, DECISIONS D-120). Pickup within about 1 m with no need to look at it is research/round_flow.md §5 (North Star [Y6S2]; Fandom). How close a defender must be to disable, and whether the planter and the defender disabling it hold still, are our placeholders. The planter crouches for the plant (a standing body; prone stays prone): Ulo's call, 2026-10-29; whether disabling does too is open. `siteSight` is how attackers find the site until drones exist (Phase 7): one of them has a bomb in view, with nothing in the way, within `rangeM` and `coneDeg` off the view. Metres and degrees.
